additionalFiles: One-click process-env launcher, Chinese guide, four-category feedback template, five protected synthetic sample files
launcherSource:
@echo off
setlocal DisableDelayedExpansion
if not exist "%~dp0app\Ningmao-Preview-0.1.0-x64.exe" (
 echo Please extract the entire package first.
 pause
 exit /b 1
)
set "NINGMAO_DATA_DIR=%~dp0trial-data"
set "WEBVIEW2_USER_DATA_FOLDER=%~dp0trial-webview"
start "" /D "%~dp0app" "%~dp0app\Ningmao-Preview-0.1.0-x64.exe"
exit /b
isolation: Fresh trial-data and trial-webview under delivery folder; no prior test DB or browser profile included
publication: Local user delivery only; no GitHub Release, merge or software installation
